name: Corrupted Passenger

source.note: The Specter's block, worn by the Ghostlight Express's corrupted passengers in Act 1. Its Life Drain can't take a maximum below half and lasts only the fight (docs/rules/deviations.md). The words are ours.

languages: one other language (understands but can't speak)

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.summary: Moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain; 5 (1d10) Force if it ends a turn inside one.
traits.text: The specter can move through other creatures and through objects, treating them as Difficult Terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it takes 5 (1d10) Force damage.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.summary: Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while in sunlight.
traits.text: While the specter is in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.summary: Necrotic touch that also lowers the target's Hit Point maximum by the damage taken, never below half, until the fight ends.
actions.text: Hit: 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum drops by the damage it took, though never below half of what it was, and comes back when the fight is over.

summary: A pale passenger gone wrong, drifting through the seats to touch the living and leave them weak for the rest of the fight.
